reason: My Excel works and I am proud of it. I do not want to move all my clients and debts to a new system and retrain my people for something I do not need yet.
objection: Nobody I know uses it, there are no references, and if the company is gone in a year I lose my client list and my staff learned a tool for nothing. $29 a month is also a lot when I earn $9,000 a year.
would_change_my_mind: A friend who runs a shop like mine uses it and shows me it, plus a free trial where they load my Excel for me and I pay nothing for a few months.
